signInIntro: Your characters are saved to your Google account.

notConfigured.title: Firebase is not configured yet
notConfigured.body: Fill in src/firebase/config.ts following the setup steps in README.md.

characters.title: Your characters
characters.invalid: (not a valid character — old test entry?)
characters.importFailed: The file is not a valid character:
characters.creatorLater: The character creator comes in a later milestone; until then use the sample or a character file.

content.empty: Only SRD content is available: shared official content has not been uploaded yet.
content.noAccess: Only SRD content is available: you have not been invited to the shared official content. Ask the app owner.
content.error: Shared official content could not be loaded: {{message}}

rules.ctrlHint: Hold Ctrl (Cmd on Mac) and point at anything from the rules to preview it; Ctrl+click opens the rules page. On a phone, press and hold.
rules.noDirectLink: No direct page: Ctrl+click opens a search. In edit mode you can add a link.

sheet.invalid: This entry is not a valid character.
sheet.computeFailed: The sheet could not be computed: {{message}}.
sheet.actionsHint: Click an action to use it: costs are paid and the turn tracker updates.
sheet.layoutHint: Layout of the sheet on this device (two columns suit laptops)

settings.title: Settings
settings.linksHint: Website opened by Ctrl+click on rules, per edition.

turnModeHints.strict: You can use only what is left this turn; then click New turn. Attacks can still be taken as a Reaction or Bonus action, and anything can be allowed once.
turnModeHints.track: The tracker counts what you used and flashes when you go over, but never blocks.
turnModeHints.off: No turn tracker and no New turn button.

settings.effectsHint: Small flavor effects for attacks, damage, healing and rests. If your system asks to reduce motion, they only fade and never shake.

admin.title: Content admin
admin.intro: Upload private/official-content.json (made by scripts/merge-packs.ts) or a single book from private/packs/. Pick which books to upload.
admin.restricted: Only invited e-mails can see the shared content
admin.deleteConfirm: Delete all uploaded official content? Characters then only see SRD content until you upload again.
admin.deletePackConfirm: Delete {{name}} from the shared content? Characters using it lose its content until you upload it again.
admin.uploadPicked: Upload selected ({{count}}), keep the other books
admin.uploadHint: “Upload selected” adds new books and updates existing ones; books not in the file stay. You can also pick a single book file from private/packs/.
admin.replaceAllConfirm: Replace all shared content? Books not selected here will be removed.

adjust.clickToSet: Click to type a new value
adjust.signHint: Type +{{n}} or -{{n}}, or press + / − next to the field.

turn.ignoreHint: For rules the app doesn't know (e.g. Haste)
turn.switch2024: Each attack: you may draw or stow one weapon.
turn.switch2014: One free object interaction per turn (draw or stow a weapon).
turn.cleaveHint: Cleave: after a melee hit, attack a second creature within 5 ft (once per turn).
turn.offhandHint: Extra attack with a second Light weapon ({{damage}}, no ability modifier unless negative or a feature adds it). Bonus Action; with Nick part of the Attack action.
turn.throwHint: Throw it (uses one from the stack; pick it up after the fight). Clicking the row is a melee attack.

errors.notLatest: Only the most recent change can be undone. Use the Undo button at the top.
errors.notDying: Death saves are rolled only at 0 HP while not stable or dead.
errors.chooseBase: Choose which weapon or armor it is.
errors.attunementFull: All three attunement slots are used. End an attunement first.
errors.slotTooLow: That slot is lower than the spell.
errors.notRitual: This spell can’t be cast as a ritual here.
errors.spellTooHigh: Level {{level}} is too high for this class now.
errors.spellbookFull: The spellbook has its {{max}} free spells; more only by copying.
errors.spellbookRemove: Spells don't disappear from a spellbook.

swapUsed.levelUp: {{name}}: the spell replacement for this level is used up.
swapUsed.longRestOne: {{name}}: the spell replacement for this Long Rest is used up.

errors.spellbookLevel: No free place for a level {{level}} spell; only by copying.
errors.schoolLimit: Only {{schools}} spells, except {{max}} from any school.
errors.slotTooHigh: A level {{level}} spell slot isn’t allowed here.

rest.hitDiceHint: Roll the dice and enter each result; Constitution ({{con}}) is added per die.
rest.foodAndDrink: 5e (2014): exhaustion goes down only if the character also ate and drank.
rest.dawn: Dawn passes during the rest (items recharge)
rest.zeroHp: A Long Rest needs at least 1 HP. Heal first (or stabilize and regain 1 HP).

history.title: History

items.unconscious: Dropped to 0 HP: Unconscious, death saves start
items.deathSaveFailure: Damage at 0 HP: death save failures {{before}} → {{after}}
items.slotCreated: Spell slot (level {{level}}) created from Sorcery Points
items.slotConverted: Spell slot (level {{level}}) turned into Sorcery Points
items.spellCopied: Copied {{name}} into the spellbook ({{gp}} GP, {{hours}} h)

history.undoPastConfirm: Undo “{{what}}”? Changes made after it stay (HP, uses and dice are recounted).
history.undoPastHint: Undo this even though other things happened after it

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.capacityHint: Carrying capacity: Strength × 15 lb, adjusted for size (Powerful Build counts one size larger).
inventory.versatileHint: Versatile: {{dice}} when used with two hands

itemFilters.foreignHint: Item from the other edition: it works by the rules of its own edition.

edit.banner: Edit mode: click any value or name to change it. Changed values are marked ✎; ↺ returns the computed value.
edit.clickToOverride: Click to type your own value
edit.confirmResetAll: Return all {{count}} manually changed values to the computed ones?
edit.name: Name
edit.emptyResets: Leave a field empty to use the original.
edit.baseScoreHint: Score before bonuses (rolled, point buy or standard array)

reminders.placeholder: Own reminder, e.g. “Owes the Zhentarim 50 GP”

spells.title: Spellcasting
spells.noSlots: No slot left for this spell.
spells.ritualHint: Takes 10 minutes longer and uses no slot.
spells.overLimit: This goes over the class limit (or the spell level is too high). Add it anyway, e.g. because the DM allows it?
spells.addDmHint: Always prepared and not counted against your limits.
spells.none: No spells yet. Use “Manage spells” to choose them.
spells.favoritesHint: Starred spells appear in the action list
spells.castHow: Cast with a higher slot, as a ritual…
spells.castHint: Casts right away with the lowest slot that fits (Undo takes it back)

rules.spellbook: Spellbook: two Wizard spells for free with each Wizard level (of a level you have slots for); more only by copying them from a scroll or another book.
rules.copyConfirm: The spellbook already has its {{max}} free spells. Copy {{name}} from a scroll or another book? (Costs {{gp}} GP and {{hours}} hours.)
rules.bookRemoveConfirm: Spells don't disappear from a spellbook. Remove {{name}} anyway?
rules.swapNoneConfirm: The rules don't let this class replace spells. Remove {{name}} anyway?
rules.swapCantripsNoneConfirm: The rules don't let this class replace cantrips. Remove {{name}} anyway?
rules.swapUsedLevelUpConfirm: {{name}} may replace one spell per level gained, and it is used up. Remove {{name}} anyway?
rules.swapUsedLongRestConfirm: {{name}} may replace one spell per Long Rest, and it is used up. Remove {{name}} anyway?
rules.copyLevelConfirm: The free places left only hold lower-level spells (more come with Wizard levels). Copy {{name}} (level {{level}}) from a scroll or another book? (Costs {{gp}} GP and {{hours}} hours.)
rules.noFreePlaces: No free spells left to add until the next Wizard level.
rules.thisLevel: This level: {{added}}/{{of}} new spells in the spellbook (up to level {{level}})
rules.schoolConfirm: Only {{schools}} spells, except {{max}} from any school, and those are used. Learn {{name}} anyway?

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
items: Preview rules of a highlighted name
Open the rules page (wikidot) in a new tab
Confirm a typed number or name
Cancel editing, close the side panel

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.hint: Found a bug or missing something? Write it here — it goes straight to the author.

placeholder.bug: What happened, and what did you expect? Which character / screen?
placeholder.idea: What would you like the app to do?

admin.title: Feedback
admin.emailHint: URL of your Google Apps Script web app; every new feedback is sent to your Gmail through it. Empty = no e-mails.
admin.howTo: How to set it up (2 minutes)

font.convert: Turn a spell slot into Sorcery Points:

levelUp.title: Level up to {{level}}
levelUp.multiclassHint: A new class is multiclassing: you must meet its ability requirements and those of your current classes.
levelUp.hpCon: Your Constitution modifier ({{con}}) is added; a level always gives at least 1 HP.
levelUp.noNewFeatures: No new features at this level.
levelUp.noSubclass: No subclass available (more in rule packs).
levelUp.stillOpen: {{count}} choices are still open. You can finish them later from the ⚠️ button on the sheet.
levelUp.badgeHint: Choices the character hasn't made yet (skills, expertise, feats, spells…)
levelUp.levelDownConfirm: Remove the last level ({{what}}) and the choices made at it?
levelUp.showMade: Show choices already made (to change them)

change.never: The rules don't let this choice change once made. Change it anyway?
change.levelUp: This can change only when you gain a level (in Level up). Change it now anyway?

create.title: New character
create.higherLevelHint: You create the character at level 1; then Level up runs for each level up to {{level}} (HP average pre-filled).
create.bgBonusesHint: +2 to one and +1 to another, or +1 to all three.

methodHint.pointBuy: 27 points; each score from 8 to 15 (14 costs 7, 15 costs 9).
methodHint.roll: Roll four d6 and drop the lowest, six times; or enter your rolls from the table.

create.orEnter: or type the rolled scores below
create.choicesHint: Skills, languages, feats and spells your class, species and background let you choose. You can finish them later from the ⚠️ button.
create.goldInstead2014: Instead of the equipment, start with gold (amount from your DM / the Player's Handbook):
create.goldInstead2024: Instead of the equipment, start with gold:
create.higherGear2024: Higher starting level: the DM may add money and magic items (SRD 5.2.1 table: level 5–10 +500 GP + 1d10 × 25 GP, 11–16 +5,000 GP + 1d10 × 250 GP…). Add them in the inventory.
create.higherGear2014: Higher starting level: extra money and magic items are up to your DM; add them in the inventory.
create.name: Name
create.thenLevelUp: After saving, Level up runs up to level {{level}}.
create.openChoices: {{count}} choices still open (can be finished later).

books.title: Allowed books
books.hint: Content from these books is offered (choices, level up, spells). SRD is always on.
books.none: No books are uploaded yet; only SRD content is available.
books.legacyHint: With the DM's OK, the 2024 rules allow older subclasses: their features before level 3 come at level 3; Ki uses Focus Points; spells use the 2024 versions where they exist.
books.legacyOriginsHint: Content of another edition, marked ⚠️ 5e. Older species give no ability increases in 2024 (they come from the background); older feats count as general feats (level 4+).
books.otherEditionHint: From another edition (5e 2014): check with your DM; the 2024 rules may work differently.

homebrew.title: Homebrew
homebrew.intro: Your own content: features, subclasses, feats, species, backgrounds, items and spells. It's available to all your characters of the pack's edition. Share it by exporting a file.
homebrew.deleteConfirm: Delete the pack {{name}}? Characters using it lose its content.
homebrew.broken: {{count}} stored pack(s) could not be read.
homebrew.importHint: A file exported from this app or written by hand (docs/content-format.md).
homebrew.replaceConfirm: You already have {{name}}. Replace it? (Cancel imports a copy.)
homebrew.packHint: Changes save per entry. Use the content on a character: level up / choices offer it, edit mode → Add feature, inventory → Add item, Spellcasting → spells.

typeHints.feature: A class / subclass feature, or anything the DM grants (add it to a character in edit mode).
typeHints.subclass: Pick the class, then add features per level.
typeHints.feat: Offered in feat choices (2024: by category).
typeHints.species: Size, speed and traits (traits are features of this pack).
typeHints.subspecies: A lineage / subrace of any species.
typeHints.background: Skills, tools, origin feat and ability options (2024).
typeHints.item: Weapon, armor or magic item; appears in Add item.
typeHints.spell: Appears in the class lists you tick.

homebrew.jsonHint: The whole entry as JSON: everything the engine supports (choices, scaling, conditions…) — see docs/content-format.md. Saving checks it.

f.name: Name
f.descriptionHint: one or two lines, shown in lists and on Ctrl+hover
f.levelsHint: tick features of this pack, or create a new one
f.repeatable: Can be taken more than once
f.abilityOptionsHint: the three abilities the background may raise

m.idHint: activities spend it by this id
m.costHint: resource id (own, or a class pool)
m.onHit: Rider on a hit (listed with attacks)
m.attacksHint: natural weapons and the like, listed with weapons
m.moreInJson: Choices, scaling by level and other options: JSON tab.

homebrew.notJson: The file isn’t valid JSON (a missing comma, quote or bracket?):
homebrew.invalidPack: The pack doesn’t match the format (docs/content-format.md). What’s wrong:

theme.title: Theme
theme.accountHint: The default for all your characters. Each character can have its own (🎨 on its sheet).
theme.characterHint: This character's theme. The first tile follows your account setting.
theme.framesHint: Decorated frames around the boxes in the theme's style (illustrated themes only). Boxes get a little more room.

shape.title: Wild Shape
shape.knownHint: You know a limited number of Beast forms; mark them with ★ (you can change one on a Long Rest).
shape.noKnown: No known forms yet: mark some with ★ under All eligible beasts.
shape.noSpells: You can’t cast spells in Wild Shape.

companions.title: Companions
companions.none: No companion yet. Add a familiar, steed, beast companion or summon from your features and spells.

export.title: Export to a character sheet (PDF)
export.hint: Pick a sheet, give it its PDF once (kept in this browser) and download it filled with this character.
export.pdfReady: The PDF of this sheet is ready in this browser.
export.needPdf: Upload the PDF of this sheet ({{file}}); it stays in this browser.
export.newHint: Any character sheet PDF: the app analyses it and suggests where each value goes; you check and correct it, then save it as a template.
export.analyzed: Found {{found}} of {{total}} form fields; check the rest in the editor.
export.noFields: The PDF has no form fields: draw text boxes where values go (drag on the page) and dots for proficiencies (click).
export.noText: The PDF has no form fields and no readable text (it’s a picture): draw text boxes and dots by hand.
export.missing: {{count}} fields of the template weren’t found in this PDF.
export.sizeMismatch: This PDF has different pages than the template “{{name}}” expects. Use it anyway?
export.markField: Dot (filled when the value is checked)
export.editorHint: Click a box on the page to choose what goes there. On sheets without form fields drag to add a text box, or pick “Dot” and click a proficiency circle. Values of this character are shown as a preview.
export.looksLike: This looks like the sheet “{{name}}”, which already has a template. Use it?
export.desktopHint: A file with this character and all its values. The desktop app (any sheet PDF or image, analysed by AI) fills it into the sheet you open there.
export.desktopDownload: Character file for the desktop app

sheetImport.title: Import from a sheet: {{name}}
sheetImport.summary: Matched {{matched}} names to your content; {{unmatched}} not found (they go into the notes).
